forbidden: This page belongs to another signed-in connection.
invalid: The page request could not be validated.
expired: This page session expired. Open it again.
conflict: This interaction ID was already used for a different request.
inactive: This page is suspended or is already handling an interaction.
stale: The page changed. Refresh it before trying again.
confirmation: Confirm this action on its permission card before continuing.
negotiation: This client cannot open a native streaming page.
quota: Too many pages are open. Close a page and try again.
